title: Phase 4: release matrix, container, and examples
objective: Produce the platform build matrix with checksums, a minimal container image, and usage examples for TypeScript, Python, Go, and raw HTTP.
acceptance: a user can run the binary or image with no Go toolchain, model, or provider SDK
public documentation states fake-jev does not simulate model quality
nextAction: merge FJ-042 into main and re-verify the combined state
notes: PM note 2026-10-02: constraint reminders for the coder - examples must add no dependency and must not require network or credentials (C-QUAL-005); a Go example must still compile under the root module or carry its own go.mod inside examples/; the release workflow must not make release.yml break the normal CI workflow; and README.md must state that fake-jev does not simulate model quality or intelligence (spec section 32).

PM ruling 2026-10-02: QA flagged that README advertised '--log-format text|json' while internal/cli validates the flag but emits identical text for both values. FJ-042's non-goal forbids implementing JSON logging, so the fix was to make the documentation accurate (the flag is accepted and validated; JSON output is not implemented) and the missing JSON log output is now tracked as FJ-062. QA also flagged that the documented 'run ... -- npm test' example could not work in this repository (no npm script); the cleaner revision replaced the child command with a command that genuinely runs.
